title: GoldenEntry
description: A single entry in the RAG Q&A golden dataset

id.description: Unique identifier for this golden example, e.g. 'gt-001'

question.description: The user question posed to the RAG system

context.description: The retrieved context chunk(s) that should ground the answer

expected_answer.description: The ideal correct answer, used as ground truth

tags.description: Optional tags for categorising the example, e.g. ['multi-hop', 'negation', 'numerical']

difficulty.description: Subjective difficulty level of the example

source.description: Where this golden example came from: 'human', 'synthetic', 'promoted_from_production'

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this entry was created
